200/1200 Public Promotional Housing (LPP)
MIXED-USE RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT
Delivery of 200 residential units within the wider 1,200-home Sidi Abdallah master programme, integrating public promotional housing (LPP) with ground-floor commercial and professional premises.

The development introduces high-density residential blocks configured as ground floor plus 9 upper floors (R+9), accommodating F3 and F4 apartment layouts alongside active street-level commercial frontage.

The construction scope focused on the execution of secondary trades and interior fit-out works for the dense residential blocks. Facade articulation, internal circulation cores, and technical services were coordinated to align with the master plan's structural and spatial constraints.

By integrating ground-floor retail and professional spaces directly beneath the R+9 residential massing, the architectural layout establishes a functional mixed-use profile that supports local economic activity within the urban pole.
A public housing delivery where secondary trades, service premises, and R+9 density work together to support a new urban district.

What is the scope of the 200/1200 LPP housing project?
It comprises the delivery of 200 public promotional housing (LPP) units, configured with ground-floor commercial spaces, within a larger 1,200-unit urban development in Sidi Abdallah.
What construction works were executed on this site?
The contract encompassed secondary trades and interior fit-out works for the R+9 residential blocks, excluding the primary roads and utility networks (VRD) package.
How are the residential buildings configured?
The buildings are structured as ground floor plus 9 upper floors (R+9), containing F3 and F4 apartment layouts designed to integrate with the surrounding urban pole.
